title: Star Dice
description:
🎲 Roll. Connect. Explode.

Your spaceship runs on nine dice arranged in a 3×3 grid.

After each roll, all possible lines are scored:

• Horizontal, vertical, and diagonal connections all count.

Every roll is a choice between strategy and risk.

🔧 Build Your Dice Engine

Dice are fully customizable.

• Change face values

• Add special abilities

• Adjust roll probabilities

Create consistent scaling builds or chase high-risk, high-reward combos.

Every run is a new experiment.

🧿 Relics That Break the Game

Collect powerful Relics that change how the rules work.

Turn impossible rolls into guaranteed explosions.

Relics can be fused and enchanted, causing their effects to spiral completely out of control.

🚀 A Roguelite Journey

Explore 100+ challenging levels and push your limits across 7 difficulty levels.

• Random Relics and dice modifications

• Multiple build paths and strategies

Failure isn’t punishment — it’s progress toward a stronger run.

🌌 Explore Unknown Stars and Collect Endless Possibilities

Pilot different spaceships and take on challenges across the galaxy.

Each spaceship offers a unique playstyle, allowing you to combine dice, Relics, and Enchantments to create your own strategic builds.

🚀 10+ Unique Spaceships
Discover different abilities and playstyles, opening up new ways to challenge the stars.

🧿 180+ Relics
Combine powerful effects and uncover unexpected synergies.

✨ 20+ Enchantments
Enhance your dice and create even more extreme builds.

📚 700+ Compendium Entries
Collect everything you discover throughout your journey and complete your star collection.
description_short: A turn-based roguelike strategy game about crafting powerful builds through dice customization and relic synergies. Optimize your 3×3 dice grid, trigger massive combo chains, and reach unbelievable scores.
